player_prompt.intro:
U amukeriwe eka Lights Out! U na gridi ya {size}x{size} ya tivhi.
Kongomiso ya wena i ku pfala tivhi HINKWATO (tikiwahiwa hi '.').
Loko u bula tivhi, yi pfala yi yona NASWONA yi pfala tivhi tindlela ya yona (e n'wana/e tlhelo/e hansi/e vuxeni).
Tsala [row col] ku bula tivhi (0-indexed, kutani vukulu lebyi humelelaka i 0-{max_index}).
U na ku fika {max_turns} miphumo ku gudisa puzzle.
Legendi: 'O' = tivhi yi pfuriwile, '.' = tivhi yi pfaliwile

board.current_state:
Mpimo wa gridi wa sweswi (Mpfuneto {moves_made}, {moves_left} mpfuneto wu sala, {completion}% wu hetile):
{grid}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Xiendlo xi fanele ku va hi fomati [row col] laha rhavi na kholomu swi nga tinhlayo leti heleleke kusuka eka 0 kuya ka {max_index}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Ku hlamuriwa ku fanele ku va kati ka 0 na {max_index}. U tsale [{row},{col}].

outcome.win: Ndza ku bumabumela, u tlhantlhe xiga-ririmi lexi hi {moves_used}!
